lanes.entryAuthorization: paper intents only through the existing H43-X kernel
lanes.prerequisite: Fresh Chainlink RTDS, certified resolver, frozen q99.5 artifact and executable book.
lanes.killRule: Do not tune. Reject at the registered read if either half is non-positive, clustered LCB is not above zero, or latency/capacity fails.
lanes.note: Current positive result is tiny and not promotion evidence.

lanes.entryAuthorization: none until finite-state proof, walked depth and orphan reserve are all positive
lanes.prerequisite: Exact predicate/resolver/time/precision identity and all terminal states compiled.
lanes.killRule: A candidate with any negative terminal state, stale leg, insufficient depth or negative orphan-stressed economics is vetoed.
lanes.note: A scanner may run continuously because it proves identities rather than mining outcome P&L.

lanes.entryAuthorization: none until statewise and executable proof
lanes.prerequisite: Exhaustive state space, immutable rule hashes, current fees, synchronized depth.
lanes.killRule: UNKNOWN rule state, uncovered payoff state or non-positive stressed capacity is an automatic veto.
lanes.note: Arithmetic anomalies without executable economics count as zero opportunities.

lanes.entryAuthorization: paper only after every identity dimension is CERTIFIED_EQUAL
lanes.prerequisite: Subject, predicate, comparator, strike, resolver, instant, timezone, precision and fallback all equal.
lanes.killRule: CERTIFIED_DIFFERENT or UNKNOWN is a hard veto; no risk-free label without a terminal payoff proof.

lanes.entryAuthorization: five-share paper state machine only for fully certified pairs
lanes.prerequisite: Synchronized A/B books, per-market Kalshi fees and 5/10/25-share replays.
lanes.killRule: Do not broaden semantic matching to create trades. Reject if 300 clean pair-days fail post-four-fee P&L and mismatch stress.
lanes.note: Convergence is risky statistical arbitrage, never automatically risk-free.

lanes.entryAuthorization: none for term interpolation; paper only after exact-expiry A-grade mapping
lanes.prerequisite: Exact expiry/observation mapping, sequenced bid/ask IV and executable perpetual hedge.
lanes.killRule: DVOL or unsupported interpolation remains diagnostic and cannot count as a trade.
lanes.note: The current zero-entry result is the honest result, not a collector failure.

lanes.independentUnit: one proposed relationship before deterministic verification

lanes.killRule: Any unverified AI relation is discarded; measured value is verifier-approved coverage, not model confidence.

lanes.entryAuthorization: none until public replay passes; later paper quotes still receive zero queue credit by default

lanes.killRule: Reject if lower-bound spread/reward does not exceed adverse markout at 100/250/500 ms.
lanes.note: Generic public-flow and symmetric maker results remain negative controls.

lanes.entryAuthorization: paper intents only through the exact first-intent wrapper
